title: Anniversary Wishes for Husband and Wife: 90 Heartfelt Messages
h1: Anniversary Wishes for Husband and Wife: 90 Heartfelt, Funny and Short Messages
description: Find the right anniversary wishes for husband and wife: 90 romantic, funny, short and milestone messages for cards, texts and toasts, plus writing tips.
keyword: anniversary wishes for husband and wife
excerpt: Ninety anniversary wishes for your husband or wife, from romantic and funny to short card messages and milestone notes, plus tips to make them personal.
intro:
Another year of shared coffee, inside jokes, hard days, good days and choosing each other again. An anniversary is the perfect moment to put into words what you usually show in a hundred small ways, but staring at a blank card can make even the most loving spouse freeze up.

This collection of anniversary wishes for husband and wife gives you 90 messages to borrow, tweak or use as a springboard. You’ll find romantic and funny wishes for him and for her, notes for first and milestone anniversaries, short lines for texts and cards, and a few longer letters you can personalize. There’s also a quick guide to making any message feel unmistakably yours.
body:
How to write an anniversary message that feels personal

The best anniversary wishes don’t need to be poetic. They need to sound like you and reflect your shared life. A simple formula helps:

  1. Open with warmth. “Happy anniversary, my love” or a pet name only you use.
  2. Add one specific memory or detail. The rainy wedding day, the first apartment, the road trip where everything went wrong.
  3. Name something you appreciate. How they make you laugh, how they show up, how they parent, how they make home feel like home.
  4. Look ahead. A hope, a plan or a promise for the year to come.
Tip: Take any wish below and add one sentence that only the two of you would understand. That single detail turns a nice message into a treasured one.

Romantic anniversary wishes for your husband

  1. Happy anniversary to the man who still makes my heart skip when he walks in the door.
  2. Every year with you feels like the best one yet. I can’t wait to see what this one brings.
  3. You are my calm, my laughter and my favorite person. Happy anniversary, love.
  4. Marrying you was the easiest decision I’ve ever made, and I’d make it again every single day.
  5. Thank you for building a life with me that feels like home wherever we are.
  6. I fall in love with you in new ways every year: your patience, your kindness, the way you laugh at your own jokes.
  7. To my husband, my partner and my best friend: happy anniversary. I’m so lucky it’s you.
  8. Through every season, you’ve held my hand. Here’s to holding it through many more.
  9. You’re the answer to every “what if” I ever had. Happy anniversary.
  10. Another year of loving you, and somehow my heart still has more room.
  11. With you, ordinary days feel like little adventures. Happy anniversary to my favorite adventure partner.
  12. You make me braver, softer and happier. Thank you for loving me so well.
  13. I still choose you, every morning and every night. Happy anniversary.
  14. The best parts of my life all have you in them.
  15. Here’s to us: the late-night talks, the silly dances in the kitchen and the forever we’re building.

Romantic anniversary wishes for your wife

  1. Happy anniversary to the woman who turned my world into something brighter.
  2. Every year with you is my favorite chapter. I can’t wait to keep writing our story.
  3. You’re the first person I want to tell everything to. Happy anniversary, my love.
  4. Thank you for your patience, your laughter and the way you make every place feel like home.
  5. I still get a little nervous when you smile at me. Happy anniversary, beautiful.
  6. You’re my best decision, my biggest blessing and my favorite hello.
  7. Loving you is the easiest and most meaningful thing I do.
  8. To my wife, my partner and my safe place: happy anniversary.
  9. Another year beside you, and I’m more in love than ever.
  10. You make the hard days lighter and the good days unforgettable.
  11. I would marry you all over again, and I’d say yes even faster.
  12. Here’s to the woman who knows me best and loves me anyway.
  13. You’ve made my life richer in ways I never imagined. Thank you for being mine.
  14. Every day with you is a gift I never take for granted.
  15. Happy anniversary to the love of my life, today and every day after.

Funny anniversary wishes for husband and wife

Perfect for couples who show love through teasing and laughter.

For him

  1. Happy anniversary to the man who still can’t find anything in the fridge but somehow always finds my heart.
  2. Another year of you stealing the blanket. I love you anyway.
  3. Thanks for putting up with me for another year. Your prize is… more of me.
  4. Happy anniversary! I’d still pick you over pizza, and that’s saying something.
  5. You’re my favorite person to annoy for the rest of my life.
  6. Cheers to another year of me being right and you being handsome.
  7. Happy anniversary to my husband, my partner in snacks and my official spider remover.
  8. We’ve survived another year of assembling furniture together. That’s true love.
  9. I love you more than you love the remote. Almost.
  10. Happy anniversary! Still crazy about you, and still crazy enough to keep you.

For her

  1. Happy anniversary to the woman who’s been patiently training me for years. I’m almost there.
  2. Another year, and you still laugh at my jokes. That’s how I know it’s real love.
  3. Thank you for marrying me. I know you had options. I’m very glad you made this one.
  4. Happy anniversary to my wife, who is always right, even when I’m sure she isn’t.
  5. I love you more than coffee. Please don’t tell the coffee.
  6. Another year of you stealing fries off my plate. I wouldn’t have it any other way.
  7. Happy anniversary to my favorite roommate, travel buddy and thermostat negotiator.
  8. You’re stuck with me forever, and I’m thrilled about it.
  9. Here’s to another year of me pretending I didn’t hear “we need to talk about the dishes.”
  10. Happy anniversary! You still give me butterflies, and occasionally indigestion from your cooking experiments.

First anniversary wishes

  1. One year down, a lifetime to go. Happy first anniversary, my love.
  2. Our first year of marriage taught me that “forever” with you sounds perfect.
  3. Happy first anniversary to my favorite newlywed.
  4. A year ago we said “I do.” Today, I still do, even more.
  5. The first of many anniversaries. I can’t wait to celebrate them all with you.
  6. One year of being your husband (or wife) is the best title I’ve ever held.
  7. Here’s to our first year of shared groceries, shared dreams and shared everything.
  8. Happy first anniversary. I love our little life together so much.

Feeling nostalgic about the wedding? Revisit our wedding vow examples and borrow a line or two for your card.

Milestone anniversary wishes

  1. 5 years: Five years of love, laughter and learning each other by heart. Here’s to the next fifty.
  2. 10 years: A decade of us. Thank you for ten years of choosing me, even on my grumpy days.
  3. 15 years: Fifteen years in, and you’re still my favorite person to come home to.
  4. 20 years: Twenty years of building a life, a home and a love I’m proud of. Happy anniversary.
  5. 25 years: A silver anniversary for a golden partner. Twenty-five years, and I’d do every one again.
  6. 30 years: Thirty years of you holding my hand. I hope you never let go.
  7. 40 years: Forty years of marriage, and you still make my heart race. Happy ruby anniversary.
  8. 50 years: Half a century of love. Our story is my favorite one ever told.

Short anniversary wishes for cards and texts

Quick, sweet and easy to send.

  1. Happy anniversary to my forever person.
  2. Still you. Always you.
  3. Another year, another reason to love you.
  4. My favorite love story is ours.
  5. Grateful for you today and every day.
  6. Here’s to us, babe.
  7. Love you more than yesterday, less than tomorrow.
  8. Best decision ever: you.
  9. Happy anniversary to my best friend.
  10. You + me = my favorite equation.
  11. Cheers to another year of us.
  12. I’d marry you all over again.
  13. You are my home.
  14. Thank you for loving me so well.
  15. Happy anniversary, my heart.
  16. Forever sounds good with you.
  17. Every year with you is my favorite year.
  18. Lucky me, I get to keep you.
  19. Still falling for you, one year at a time.
  20. To many more years of us being us.

Posting a photo to celebrate? Pair it with something from our wedding captions for Instagram.

Longer anniversary messages you can personalize

Use these as a starting point for a card, letter or toast. Swap in your own memories and details.

For your husband

Happy anniversary, my love. When I think back to the day we got married, I remember being nervous about everything except you. You were the one thing I was sure of, and you still are. This year brought its share of surprises, but every time things got hard, I looked over and you were right there. Thank you for your steady heart, your terrible puns and the way you always make sure I’ve eaten. I love the life we’re building, and I can’t wait to see what we do next.

To my husband: I don’t say it enough, but I notice all the little things you do. The coffee you make before I wake up, the way you check the locks at night, how you listen when I need to vent. Those small moments are what love looks like to me. Happy anniversary. I’m proud to be your wife and even prouder to be your partner.

For your wife

Happy anniversary to the woman who changed my life for the better. Before you, I didn’t know a home could feel this warm or that laughter could be this easy. You make everything brighter, from the hardest Mondays to the laziest Sundays. Thank you for believing in me, for forgiving me when I mess up and for loving me exactly as I am. I promise to keep choosing you, every day, for the rest of my life.

To my wife: Another year has gone by, and somehow I love you more than I did on our wedding day. I love the way you see the best in people, the way you sing when you think nobody’s listening and the way you hold my hand without thinking about it. You are my favorite person and my greatest adventure. Happy anniversary, my love.

Want to go even bigger? Our I love you letters and reasons why I love you can help you write a full love letter.

Ways to deliver your anniversary wish

  • Hide notes in a coat pocket, lunch bag or bathroom mirror.
  • Write it in a card and pair it with a small gift tied to a shared memory.
  • Send a morning text so it’s the first thing they see.
  • Read it aloud over dinner, especially for milestone years.
  • Record a voice note if you’re apart on your anniversary.
Tip: Keep a folder of every anniversary card you exchange. Reading them together years later is a gift in itself.
takeaways: The best anniversary wishes include one specific memory or detail.
Match the tone to your relationship, whether romantic, funny or both.
Milestone years deserve a nod to how far you have come together.
Short texts work for busy days; longer notes shine in cards and toasts.
Delivery matters: hidden notes, morning texts and read-aloud letters add meaning.

faq.q: What do you write in an anniversary card for your spouse?
faq.a: Start with a warm greeting, mention a specific memory or quality you love, thank them for something they do, and end with a hope for the year ahead. It does not need to be long. Sincere, personal details matter far more than poetic language.

faq.q: What is a short anniversary message for my husband or wife?
faq.a: Simple lines like “Still you, always you,” “I’d marry you all over again” or “Happy anniversary to my forever person” work beautifully in texts and cards. Add their name, a pet name or a tiny inside joke to make it feel personal and unmistakably from you.

faq.q: Is it okay to use a funny anniversary message?
faq.a: Yes, if humor is part of how you connect. A funny wish can feel very personal and warm. Many couples pair a joke with a sincere line, such as a playful tease followed by “I love you more every year,” so the message lands as both fun and loving.

faq.q: What are the traditional anniversary themes?
faq.a: Some well-known traditional themes include paper for the first year, wood for the fifth, tin or aluminum for the tenth, silver for the 25th, ruby for the 40th and gold for the 50th. Many couples use these themes as inspiration for gifts and messages.
